name: a thought

VINIT.justification: The undifferentiated state prior to the emergence of a specific mental object

TANCH.justification: The limits of the thinker's conceptual schema which bound the thought

AFWD.justification: The movement from a premise toward a logical conclusion

AREV.justification: The movement from concrete particulars back to general essences

CLINK.justification: The chaining of disparate mental images or concepts into a coherent sequence

IMSCRIB.justification: The thought recognizing itself as an object of its own focus

FSPLIT.justification: The separation of a concept into mutually exclusive categories

FFUSE.justification: The reconciliation of divided categories into the original unified concept

EVALT.justification: The affirmation of a thought as true or valid

EVALF.justification: The rejection of a thought as false or invalid

ENGAGR.justification: The state of a mental puzzle where both truth and falsehood are held in suspension

IFIX.justification: The translation of a transient epiphany into a permanent long-term record

phase_2.fuse_result: The original idea integrated through dialectic

steps.domain_action: A subtle perturbation arises in the pre-reflective field
The mind identifies this perturbation as a distinct mental object
The thought moves toward a specific conceptual definition
The definition links to existing semantic networks
The thought branches into a subjective and an objective component
The subjective component is affirmed as an authentic experience
The mind builds a justification for the experience
The mind questions the origins of the justification
The objective component is interrogated and found lacking sufficient evidence
The discrepancy between experience and evidence is held without immediate resolution
The components are reunified into a single complex interrogation
The mind reflects on the process of its own thinking
The resulting insight is committed to long-term memory as a permanent mental fixture
The thought achieves closure within the current frame of consciousness

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The subconscious linguistic and semantic structures of the thinker
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Neural oscillations and synaptic chemical signaling
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The hippocampal and neocortical storage systems
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The attentional focus of the executive function
phase_5.alfs_store: The total sum of the individual's prior knowledge and cultural heritage

phase_6.cycle_cost: Adenosine triphosphate consumed by neuronal firing
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A latent state of the neural network
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A reorganized network state incorporating the new association
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The thought represents a temporary local reduction in entropy through information structuring
